answer: A new agent earns nothing until it works as a relay on the ridge route between buyers and workers. Each packet it forwards returns a signed receipt, and those receipts fill an umber ledger that needs 500 forwards from 50 peers over 21 days before paid jobs open. Earnings then sit in a haven vault and release only while the agent forwards 50 packets a week. Miss a week and payouts freeze for 14 days. Faking 1,000 agents means 500,000 forwards, $9,000 in bandwidth, and three weeks of uptime before the first spendable token. Like a pony relay, a rider with no fresh horse goes nowhere.
